title: Supersingular poles and signed residues of prime-level Fricke Hauptmoduln: manuscript, code and data (v1.11)
description:
Manuscript (version 1.11) and supplementary packages for Supersingular poles and signed residues of prime-level Fricke Hauptmoduln. For each of the fifteen prime levels N with X_0(N)^+ of genus zero and every prime p ≥ 5 with p ≠ N, the paper determines the poles and signed residues of the rational function representing T_N|U_p modulo p, proves the supersingular factorial evaluation of E_{p+1}^{(p-1)/2}, and determines the sign of (Δ(τ)/Δ(ℓτ))^{(p^2-1)/24} at supersingular points of X_0(ℓ).

The archive contains the LaTeX source and PDF, exact-arithmetic verification code, per-pair certificates and timing benchmarks. Each supplementary package has its own README and SHA-256 manifest.

Status: preprint, not yet peer reviewed. AI-assisted (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5). Code is MIT-licensed; the manuscript and notes are © 2026 David Jordan, all rights reserved, pending publication.
